name: Notify
description: One switch for the watch's phone-notification setting: R1 flips it, R2 leaves. The change takes effect immediately and lasts until the watch restarts. Turn on "Save to watch settings" below and it is written to the watch's own settings file so it survives a restart -- that path reaches into firmware internals, so it works on watch software 1.4.0 and is off until you ask for it. On firmware it does not recognise the app says so on screen and changes nothing.

configFields.label: Save to watch settings
configFields.description: Off: the switch takes effect now and reverts when the watch restarts. On: it is also saved to the watch's settings file so it survives a restart, which needs firmware this app recognises exactly.
